A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same outsourced diffusion sampling work. All main sections and Appendices A–F are readable and matchable, including equations, tables, figures, and sample galleries.

before.justification: v1 reports original image-generation and protein-generation experiments in Tables 3–6, plus distillation results and qualitative analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and adds results for further CIFAR-10 comparisons, ELBO evaluation, and outsourced sampling with Stable Diffusion 1.5.

M1.justification: The outsourced-noise target, trajectory-balance objective, diffusion architecture, and replay-buffer and annealing components are retained. The new Algorithm 1 documents training rather than establishing a new method component or redesign.

E1.justification: The established CIFAR-10, FFHQ, text-to-image RLHF, and protein-generation tasks remain. The added SD 1.5 experiment uses prompts identified only through Venkatraman et al. (2024); the supplied PDFs do not establish whether these represent distinct task coverage or merely another model configuration.

E2.justification: v2 Table 9 adds DPS and RTB to the I-CFM comparison. Table 13 adds SD 1.5 comparisons with DDPO, DPOK, and RTB, substantially broadening comparator coverage. Appendix B.4 explicitly attributes those baseline scores to earlier published results rather than claiming fresh baseline runs.

E3.justification: v2 adds estimated ELBO as an evaluation metric for I-CFM and SD3 in Tables 9 and 12, and adds an SD 1.5 configuration within text-to-image RLHF. Previously stated experimental settings remain unchanged; detailed protocols for the additions are sparse.

E4.justification: Figure 1 replaces the GAN likelihood and posterior density illustrations used to examine noise-space versus data-space complexity, modestly revising that toy example's evidence. The distillation, efficiency, and HMC-chain analyses in Appendices C and F remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Protein results in Table 6 retain standard deviations across three seeds. Existing seed and sampling disclosures are unchanged, and the added tables introduce no new uncertainty estimates, significance tests, or repeated-run reporting.

E6.justification: v2 adds substantial quantitative evidence: DPS and RTB CIFAR-10 FIDs of 84.96 and 90.77, ELBO results, and SD 1.5 results including outsourced reward 1.26 and diversity 0.14. Comparing v1 Table 11 with v2 Table 12, the SD3 horse/wolf prompt's CFG reward changes from 0.71 to 1.26 and outsourced reward from 0.94 to 1.36, with additional smaller corrections. Main Tables 3–6 retain their values; the additions do not establish gains from a changed method.

T1.justification: The noise-outsourcing proposition, posterior pushforward proposition, Appendix A.2 proof, and Appendix A.1 derivation connecting outsourced sampling to RTB are unchanged. ELBO reporting adds no mathematical definition or derivation.

C1.justification: The claims of broad prior-model applicability, effective posterior inference, and sampling efficiency remain unchanged in the introduction and conclusion. Abstract edits shorten wording without materially changing these claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning latent smoothness, HMC mixing, prior quality, reward-model limitations, and protein-training instability are retained. The new Impact Statement supplies general deployment caveats rather than a substantive new scientific limitation.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code repository link at the start of Appendix B and training pseudocode in Algorithm 1. Existing architecture, hyperparameter, hardware, and runtime disclosures are retained; these additions document the procedure without establishing implementation changes.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and conceptual positioning, including the relationship to RTB, remain unchanged. The reference-list change replaces Berner et al.'s 2022 preprint entry with its 2024 published version, rather than introducing a different cited work.

P1.justification: v2 lightly edits the abstract, adds an algorithm reference, brief descriptions of additional evaluations, and an Impact Statement, and updates publication metadata. The main narrative and appendix organization are retained.

P2.justification: v2 adds Algorithm 1 and Tables 9 and 13, expands the SD3 table with ELBO columns, and relocates existing displays. Figure 1 revises the GAN density panels and corrects the posterior label to p(x|y). The overall design and appendix sample galleries remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The additional comparisons and ELBO reporting strengthen evidence for posterior approximation, while revised SD3 reward rows resolve inconsistencies with the reported averages. The code link improves reproducibility information. These gains are limited by sparse protocols for the additions and Algorithm 1's inconsistent use of r instead of log r when computing log density; the core contribution remains stable.
